propositions: A portable public-API surface drift gate is implemented via scripts/gen_api_surface.py with --check and --update modes, introspecting pinned MODULES using pure-stdlib (inspect/importlib) without adding griffe dependency.

The gate uses a committed baseline snapshot (tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json) covering public members from the rebar facade and documented reuse subsystems, tracking callable parameters, class bases, dataclass fields, and pinned immutable constants.

A portable unit-tier test (tests/unit/test_api_surface_gate.py) runs the authoritative --check in a clean subprocess to detect removed/renamed symbols and signature changes, passing on no drift and failing with clear remediation messaging.

The hardcoded-subset assertions from deleted tests/unit/test_reuse_surface_doc.py are subsumed and verified with no coverage loss via subsumption tests for signing, prompting, runner/contracts, and workflow executor symbols.
The gate is operational and CI-portable, running under make test with no CI-provider dependency and using the same portable pattern as the existing config-key drift gate (ticket 3199/RP-04 S7.4).
